opening_question_spark: If every human vanished tomorrow, how long would this garden keep watering itself?
entry_transition: The orb reveals what happens when our hands disappear.
cta: Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
body: Within hours, roads empty and power grids begin failing.
Without operators, pumps stop and some tunnels flood.
Pets trapped indoors face danger first.
Livestock escape fences or die without care.
Weeds split pavement and vines climb buildings.
Rust, leaks, and frost weaken roofs.
Wild animals spread through quieter towns.
Satellites eventually fail or fall from orbit.
Stone, glass, plastic, and monuments can outlast generations.
optional_closing: Nature would not erase us quickly; it would build over us.
full_narration: If every human vanished tomorrow, how long would this garden keep watering itself? The orb reveals what happens when our hands disappear. Within hours, roads empty and power grids begin failing. Without operators, pumps stop and some tunnels flood. Pets trapped indoors face danger first. Livestock escape fences or die without care. Unattended fires may burn unchecked. Weeds split pavement and vines climb buildings. Rust, leaks, and frost weaken roofs. Wild animals spread through quieter towns. Satellites eventually fail or fall from orbit. Stone, glass, plastic, and monuments can outlast generations. Nature would not erase us quickly; it would build over us.
